name: Research Interviews
description: Answer the statistics, machine learning, open-case and data questions of quant research interviews.

lessonNames.l1-two-regressions: Regress y on x, then x on y
lessonNames.l10-weak-signals: Learning when the signal is weak
lessonNames.l18-updating-a-fit: Updating a fit as data arrives

lessonObjectives.l1-two-regressions: Relate the two slopes and R² to the correlation, and say what duplicating the data changes.
lessonObjectives.l2-correlation-limits: Find the range of a third correlation from two others, using a positive semidefinite matrix.
lessonObjectives.l3-estimators-on-the-spot: Derive a quick estimator with its bias and variance at a whiteboard.
lessonObjectives.l4-tests-in-words: Explain a p-value, power and a multiple-testing correction without jargon.
lessonObjectives.l5-matrices-on-the-spot: Find eigenvalues of special matrices (all-ones, rank one, projections) by reasoning, not computing.
lessonObjectives.l6-bias-variance-aloud: Explain the bias-variance trade-off with a picture and a finance example.
lessonObjectives.l7-ridge-against-lasso: Explain why the lasso sets coefficients to zero and when each penalty fits.
lessonObjectives.l8-tree-questions: Answer the standard questions on splits, bagging, boosting and feature importance.
lessonObjectives.l9-pca-questions: Explain what principal components are, how to choose how many, and when they mislead.
lessonObjectives.l10-weak-signals: Explain why prediction in finance differs: low signal to noise, changing regimes and leakage.
lessonObjectives.l11-framing-the-question: Turn "predict tomorrow's futures price" into a target, a horizon and a loss.
lessonObjectives.l12-features-and-data: Propose features and data sources, and name the leakage each could bring.
lessonObjectives.l13-baseline-first: Fit and beat a simple baseline before anything clever.
lessonObjectives.l14-house-price-case: Work a full prediction case on a dataset, answering the interviewer's follow-ups.
lessonObjectives.l15-presenting-a-result: Report a result with its uncertainty, its failure modes and the next step.
lessonObjectives.l16-interpolating: Write a linear interpolator that handles gaps, edges and unsorted input.
lessonObjectives.l17-regression-by-group: Fit one regression per group in pandas and collect the coefficients.
lessonObjectives.l18-updating-a-fit: Update a least-squares fit cheaply when a row arrives or leaves.
lessonObjectives.l19-timed-data-task: Clean, analyse and model a dataset inside a time limit.
lessonObjectives.l20-writing-a-take-home: Write a take-home report that a reviewer can check and rerun.
